strategy_roster.name: SJ NIFTY
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,20) and close > sma(close * volume,20) / sma(volume,20) and rsi(close,14) > 50 and close > ema(close,200) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,10)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20), a volume-weighted VWAP proxy, RSI(14), EMA(200), and a prior-high break approximate the documented long filter stack. SuperTrend, Keltner basis, risk sizing, and risk-ratio protection are unavailable, and the short branch is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: HMA 200 + EMA 20 Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(200) is an explicit proxy for HMA(200), while the documented close/EMA(20) crossover and opposite reversal are retained. The exact Hull calculation, timeframe, and no-stop short side are outside this long-only translation.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Scalper
strategy_roster.notes: A close recross above EMA(20) plus a prior 20-bar high break approximates the pullback-then-rebreakout stop-order logic. Pending-order arming, opposite-band protection, cooldown, and adaptive trailing modes are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Historical Volatility Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20) plus two standard deviations is the explicit proxy for the historical-volatility level, with an MA recross as the documented exit. The 2% stop is retained; the exact HV estimator and short branch are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Range Filter DW
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(14) plus/minus 2.618 ATR(14) approximates the stateful ATR range-filter bands and retains the documented multipliers. The rolling band state, opposite-band exit details, and short side are simplified for the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: ORB 15m – First 15min Breakout (Long/Short)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish prior-bar body and high break approximate the first-15-minute opening-range signal. Stockholm session timing, reference-bar stop, 10R target, and session-end exit are not available; the long branch is retained.

strategy_roster.name: Maximus vX Lite
strategy_roster.entry_long: high - low <= sma(high - low,40) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,40)
strategy_roster.notes: A 40-bar average range and prior-high break provide a consolidation-plus-breakout proxy. The source's point distances, delay, reset period, fixed stop, and trailing stop are not representable as percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Color Gradient Framework
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) zero-line direction is a direct proxy for the visual Color Gradient center-line signal. The configurable RSI period is not supplied, so 14 is a documented fallback; gradient rendering and short state are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Surefirething
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish completed candle is a fallback for the symmetric buy-limit leg, with a bearish candle as the opposite exit. The pending grid, 50-pip protection, trailing step, and midnight shutdown are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Long Only with Confirmed Crossbacks
strategy_roster.notes: The RSI(14) cross above 44 directly represents confirmation after oversold, and the documented 70 cross is the long exit. Short parameters are disabled by default; no stop or take-profit is documented.
